Heard learned counsel for the petitioner as well as learned A.G.A. for the State-respondents and
perused the material available on record.

2.  This petition seeks issuance of a writ, order or direction in the nature of Certiorari for quashing the First Information Report dated 06.05.2024 bearing F.I.R./Case Crime No. 354 of 2024 for the offence under Section 498A, 323, 506 I.P.C and 3/4 D.P Act, lodged at Police Station- Fatehpur,
District- Barabanki.
3. After arguing at some length, learned counsel for the petitioner prays to withdraw the present writ Ruksar And Others vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko. ...
